kept.name: ripgrep
kept.reason: A standard lexical search engine. Use it as the baseline when you measure what adding semantic embeddings gains you.

kept.name: openai-python-sdk
kept.reason: Gives you direct access to embedding models, so you could use it to produce the semantic vectors you're adding.

kept.name: localai
kept.reason: Serves embedding models locally through an OpenAI-compatible API and has built-in RAG. That makes it a self-hosted option for the semantic side of hybrid search.

kept.name: tiktoken
kept.reason: Counts tokens and is tagged for RAG and chunking. You'd need that when sizing and chunking markdown records before embedding them.

kept.name: dspy
kept.reason: A framework with retrieval/RAG modules and automatic pipeline optimization. It's a reference point for how RAG pipelines are built and tuned.

kept.name: strands-agents
kept.reason: An agent SDK with built-in memory and sessions. Compare its memory design with your typed-record graph approach.

kept.name: production-agentic-platforms-2026
kept.reason: Rates RAG as one criterion when evaluating production agent platforms. It shows how mainstream platforms handle retrieval.

kept.name: engraft-ngram
kept.reason: Stores facts inside the model's lookup table instead of retrieving them. It's a contrasting approach to compare against retrieval-based memory.

kept.name: claude-api-prefilter-false-positive
kept.reason: Covers how auto-memory and injected context can trip Claude's API pre-filter. A memory system that injects records into agent context could hit the same problem.
